description: This file defines an abstract base class `BaseSparsifier` for managing sparsity in neural network models within the PyTorch framework. It includes methods for configuration, state management, preparing models with parametrizations, and converting modules, all aimed at implementing sparsification techniques.

classes.name: BaseSparsifier
classes.description: An abstract base class for all sparsifiers, providing common functionalities such as configuration, state handling, model preparation, and masking operations.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] state_dict(self)
methods.description: Returns the current state of the sparsifier, including state and group configurations.

methods.name: load_state_dict(self, state_dict: dict[str, Any], strict: bool = True)
methods.description: Loads a saved sparsifier state, restoring masks and configuration groups.

methods.name: None make_config_from_model( self, model: nn.Module, SUPPORTED_MODULES: set[type[nn.Linear]] = SUPPORTED_MODULES, )
methods.description: Automatically generates sparsifier configuration by traversing the model to identify supported modules.

methods.name: _prepare(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Adds mask parametrizations to model layers based on the configuration groups.

methods.name: squash_mask( self, params_to_keep: tuple[str, ...] | None = None, params_to_keep_per_layer: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] | None = None, *args, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Finalizes the sparsity masks into the tensors and optionally saves sparsity parameters.

methods.name: convert( self, module: nn.Module, mapping: dict[type[nn.Module], type[nn.Module]] | None = None, inplace: bool = False, parameterization: type[nn.Module] = FakeSparsity, )
methods.description: Converts modules to specified types using a mapping, optionally in-place.

methods.name: None step(self, use_path: bool = True)
methods.description: Updates the masks for all groups if enabled.

methods.name: update_mask(self, module: nn.Module, tensor_name: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to update the mask for a given module and tensor name.
